_note: Derive Slack app manifest. Create the app at https://api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From a manifest, then replace every <BASE_URL> below with your Derive API origin (e.g. https://api.derive.to). Some scopes and events are forward-declared for later features: the assistant (assistant:write + assistant_thread_started) needs 'Agents & AI Apps' enabled on the app, and link unfurls (links:read/write + link_shared) need Unfurl Domains configured for derive.to. Both are wired in later PRs; the connect + event + interactivity flow works with the rest as-is. After creating the app, set SLACK_CLIENT_ID / SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET / SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET (see .env.example / DEPLOY.md).
